Visited the please as it was listed as Pioneer resellers. They agreed to get all parts to install brand new pioneer dmh-342ex to Nissan Sunny car. Requested for 2 to 3 days to get Harness side powers Etc.

I went after 4 days they did not have any of the parts. State with only harness. Which don’t work as car controllers where not working and steering controllers don’t work reverse camera don’t work.

They said no one keeps pioneers and market and suggested to go with generic android players. Wasted 4 hrs and we finally re install OEM players and installed new pioneer in friends Swift.

They charges 1500es  for 300 rs harness which did not work and was part of their RND work. And 1200rs as labour.

Highly nor recommended and owners don’t have knowledge and interested only selling Acceries like sterling covers and white led lights. The installation boy has more knowledge than the owners.

BIG no to such vendors.

** After a mother again got a call from one of the staff/ owners of the shop. I blew the call was getting recorded without my consent.
In aggressive voice wanted to keep his point which was very different till the time money was taken for service which was not provided.
He kept proving his point that he has given service and parts. Which I denied as they were not able to install Orignal Pioneer radio in my car for which they had kept the radio for 3 days.
1) they assured the car can be installed in car.
2) factory fitted reverse cam will work.
3) Staring control will work.
4) Factory fitted USB drive will not work.

On waiting 3 hours none of them worked except point 1.

They said camera will not work and needs to be replaced. Same story for steering controller and USB port.

Then installed same player in my Swift it worked.

Took the same player to popular car accessories shop in malad. With minimum charge of 3k which included labor. 3 adaptors for camera, USB and steering controller and dash bo d work was completed in 45 min.

I am afraid with the kind of tome and getting a call after posting honest review this people can find my house address and start fighting.

One again I strongly don’t recommend this people and suggest to pay little more and go to knowledge people who can resolve issue and visit popular car and Satyam car in malad west.
